title: Relay's lane start hardcodes <main>/.worktrees/<name>, so…
what: lib/relay_lanes.py:487: MEDIUM: F8 relay's lane start hardcodes <main>/.worktrees/<name>, so a lane in ALIX makes an unignored folder in its main checkout
why: 29 Oct, design review of the ALIX worktree-folder fix: outside that change. A relay lane started in ALIX would create an unignored .worktrees/ folder in its main checkout instead of using bin/wt. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A lane started for ALIX: worktree = os.path.join(main, ".worktrees", name). ALIX ignores only /.worktree/, so its main
checkout shows "?? .worktrees/", and bin/wt's deps link and alixbase config are skipped. Expected: the project's
folder (project.worktrees or derived) or its gate.wt.
pass_cases: 1. Project with project.worktrees = ".worktree": lane worktree at <main>/.worktree/<name>.

fact: Reproduced 29 Oct by reading master: lib/relay_lanes.py:487 builds the lane's worktree as os.path.join(main, ".worktrees", name) whatever the project's own worktree folder or tool (ALIX's bin/wt makes .worktree/).
